entities.summary: Kyle Daniel Rudolph is an American former professional football player who was a tight end for 12 seasons in the National Football League (NFL), primarily with the Minnesota Vikings. He played college football for the Notre Dame Fighting Irish and was selected by the Vikings in the second round of the 2011 NFL draft. He was selected for two Pro Bowls. He also played for the New York Giants and the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
